periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees downward toward the muzzle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering, with the lowest point of the patch extending significantly below its geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Deep U-shaped profile on the posterior edge of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Variable thickness, narrowing slightly at the spine and widening significantly at the lateral shoulder regions.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap between pinna regions, approximately equal to the horizontal width of the cranial surface between them.
